QuestInfo.name: Certified Knight
QuestInfo.0: You met Kia at the Knight-in-Training Test Site.
QuestInfo.1:
You must defeat the monsters that appear when you break the boxes scattered around, and collect 3 Proof of Exam items.

You can break boxes with regular attacks (Ctrl).
QuestInfo.2: You passed Kia's test! You're really going to be a Cygnus Knight!

1.0: Let me see your Proof of Exam?

yes.0: Not bad, not bad. I'm gonna give you something of my own design. You can hit X to use it.

item.0: I'm too busy to be explaining all day long. If you wanna pass this test, you'd better listen up! You need to find boxes on the map and destroy them with a Regular Attack. Beat up any monsters that show up, and pick up a Proof of Exam with the Z key. Bring me back 3, and I'll let ya pass.
